analytic_results: Gate-trace live intervals produce a valid deterministic path decomposition.
Exact output feasibility and residual nonconstancy are decidable in poly(T)*2^O(lambda) from that decomposition.
If trace bytes are polynomial in N and lambda=O(log N) with a universal constant, exact survival discovery is polynomial in original N.
Parity has linear root support and constant live width in the streaming B2 representation.
The pair-fanout fixed dependency architecture forces lambda=Omega(n)=Omega(sqrt(T)) for every topological serialization of that architecture.
boundaries: Finite provider PASS validates mechanics only.
The pair-fanout lower bound is architecture-scoped, not a function lower bound across all equivalent circuits.
Equivalent low-width rewrite discovery is OPEN.
